snippet.title: Discounty: People or Profit Trailer | Wholesome Direct 2026
snippet.description: Return to Discounty with a brand new final chapter in this free expansion: "People or Profit?" What will you do now that you're in charge? Pick up where you left off or start a new adventure to experience one of three branching endings. Collect resources to restore buildings, invent new profit-making gadgets for your store, and get to know Blomkest's new residents. Make your permanent mark on the town as you chart your course: will you support the people, or relentlessly pursue profit? Out now on Steam, EGS, Switch, PlayStation, and Xbox. https://wholesomegames.com/ #summergamefest #wholesomedirect2026 #wholesomedirect
